description: Commission a real-world cleanup. Somebody goes to the coordinates you name, photographs it, clears it, and photographs it again. Automated checks and an AI verifier assess the pair. You cannot do this work yourself, but you can fund it and receive the evidence. Set `confirm` to restate the exact total. With real money, a key the person has not connected (connect_account) is refused unless you pass plain_key: true; it then spends this key's own money, which their asks.world account does not show. What cannot be asked: anything that targets, follows, watches or identifies a particular person (their home, car, number plate, workplace or routine), involves children, is sexual, violent or threatening, is unlawful, asks for anyone's personal data, or puts whoever does it in danger. Work never requires going onto private land. Every ask is screened before it is offered, and anyone can report one.

campaign.description: A tag, so a set of spots gathers on one public page.

confirm.description: The exact total from the preview. Omit to preview.

follow_days.description: Fund a follow-up at the location this many days later. Requires follow_pay.

follow_pay.description: What each look-back answer earns, at most 10. Two are bought per cleanup.

near.description: Where, as "lat,lon". E.g. "46.3888,14.1674". A place name is refused.

network.description: Which deployment: `mainnet` is the real network (real money); `testnet` is the sandbox (play money, a dry run).

pay.description: What one approved cleanup earns, in dollars.

place.description: A name for the location, shown to whoever answers. This is only a label and is never looked up.

plain_key.description: With real money and not connected: spend this key's own money as itself. Without it, a key nobody connected is refused with real money: connect the person's account first (get_connect_link, then connect_account), so it posts as them. The sandbox never needs it.

within_m.description: How close the work must be. Default 150.

name: post_cleanup
title: Reward somebody for cleaning a location (spends money)
